title: Ruby on Rails
overview: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Ruby on Rails, a popular web development framework known for its simplicity, efficiency, and scalability. Participants will learn how to build dynamic, database-driven web applications using Rails conventions, MVC architecture, RESTful APIs, and deployment strategies. The course covers both frontend and backend development, making it ideal for full-stack developers.
audience: Aspiring Web Developers looking to master Rails
Backend Developers wanting to build scalable applications
Full-Stack Developers interested in modern web frameworks
Software Engineers & IT Professionals transitioning into web development
methodology: Hands-on Coding Exercises – Practical labs & mini-projects
Real-World Case Studies – Learning from industry use cases
Collaborative Learning – Group discussions & pair programming
Capstone Project – Building a fully functional web application
competencies: Database management with Active Record & PostgreSQL
Frontend integration with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap
Authentication & security best practices in Rails
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop full-stack web applications using Ruby on Rails
Design and manage databases using Active Record
Build RESTful APIs for web and mobile applications
Implement authentication and authorization using Devise
Deploy Rails applications on cloud platforms (Heroku, AWS, etc.)
Follow best practices in Rails development and performance optimization

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Ruby on Rails

items.text: Overview of Web Development & Rails Ecosystem
Setting up the Development Environment (Rails, RVM, Bundler, Gems)

outline.title: Module 3: Creating Your First Rails Application
Module 4: Database Management with Active Record

items.text: Implementing CRUD Operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete)

outline.title: Module 5: Working with Views & Frontend Integration

items.text: Working with AJAX & Turbo for dynamic updates
Background Jobs & Asynchronous Processing (Sidekiq, Delayed Job)

outline.title: Module 9: Deployment & DevOps for Rails Applications

items.text: Configuring & Deploying Rails Apps on Heroku & AWS

Monitoring & Logging with Rails Performance Tools
